name: How does closing coordination differ between a luxury condo and a standard home?

mainEntity.name: How does closing coordination differ between a luxury condo and a standard home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Closing coordination for a luxury condo often involves a deeper dive into condominium association financials, reserves, and specific covenants and restrictions that might not apply to a standard single-family home. There can also be more complex lien searches or transfer fees unique to high-end communities. A key difference is the meticulous review of all HOA documents to protect both buyer and seller interests.
acceptedAnswer.description: Luxury condo coordination focuses more on complex HOA financials and unique community covenants compared to standard homes.
